Welcome to the Sports Massage Center by Sachin Kamboj. Based at AR Holistic Therapies, 540 Manchester Road, we specialize in advanced recovery, chronic pain management, and holistic wellness.

I am Sachin Kamboj, a Level 4 Sports Massage and Hijama (Cupping) Therapist. Whether you are an athlete seeking performance recovery or a stroke patient regaining mobility, our tailored sessions are designed to help you live pain-free.

Expert Treatments We Provide:

—Medical & Recovery: Sports Massage (Level 4), Deep Tissue (Advanced), Myofascial Release, and Manual Lymphatic Drainage.
—Traditional Healing: Eastern Cupping Therapy (Hijama) (Level 4), Tui Na Chinese Medical Massage, Gua Sha, and Indian Head Massage.
—Holistic Wellness: Thai Massage, Swedish Full Body, Reiki (Master Level), Reflexology, and Trauma Discharge Therapy.
—NMR & PNF Stretching, Magnet Therapy, Deep Abdominal/Colon Massage.

📍 Find Us: 540 Manchester Road, Bradford, BD5 7LR. 
📞 Bookings: 07856767968 (Appointments Only)
